responsibility: Implements the tree_vector_builder methods that materialize encoded vector constants as GCC VECTOR_CST trees. In particular it provides integer-step element synthesis for pattern compression and the final build routine that finalizes the builder state, allocates the VECTOR_CST with the required pattern encoding, assigns its vector type, and copies the encoded element representation into the tree node.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line tree_vector_builder operations declared in tree-vector-builder.h, specifically the tree-specific step application and final VECTOR_CST materialization logic; unlike the header, it provides the executable definitions rather than the class interface and inline traits.
